preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: Each test case has an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) representing the size of multisets a and b.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n and len(b) == n for a, b, n in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::3]], [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]]))
preconditions.description: Each multiset a and b has exactly n elements, matching the given n for the test case.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in sum([[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3]], []) + sum([[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::3]], []))
preconditions.description: All elements in multisets a and b are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
The number of output lines matches the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda a, b: all(any((x == y) or (x == 2 * y) or (x == y // 2) for y in b) for x in a))(*(list(map(int, line.split())), list(map(int, line.split()))) for line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::3], stdin.splitlines()[3::3])) if stdout_line.strip() == 'YES' else True for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then there exists a way to transform multiset b into multiset a by doubling or halving (rounded down) elements of b any number of times.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda a, b: not all(any((x == y) or (x == 2 * y) or (x == y // 2) for y in b) for x in a))(*(list(map(int, line.split())), list(map(int, line.split()))) for line in zip(stdin.splitlines()[2::3], stdin.splitlines()[3::3])) if stdout_line.strip() == 'NO' else True for stdout_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', then it is impossible to transform multiset b into multiset a by doubling or halving (rounded down) elements of b any number of times.
